# Sofund

> Australian business finance broker. One enquiry reaches 200+ lenders; funding options are provided in writing, with lender-confirmed rates, within 48 hours.

Sofund Pty Ltd arranges business loans ($15k to $5M), asset and equipment finance, invoice finance and commercial mortgages for Australian companies. Sofund is a broker, not a lender; lenders pay our fee, clients pay nothing upfront.
